subsetPolicyRationale: `s.remodeling.remodeling@1` is this plugin's own self-contained photogrammetry remodeling document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-stream, delete-stream, change-stream-sync, add-stream-frame, remove-stream-frame, replace-stream-source, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
